data.title: 周防天音 · 车库独处机车旁私密自抚情愫
data.description: 深夜私人车库里，成年天音靠着停放的机车，一只靴子踩在维修支架上；连体皮衣拉链松开，工作灯映在镀铬部件上。
data.location: 私人车库重型机车旁倚坐
data.action: 一手扶车把，另一手伸入松开的连体衣下，一脚踩维修架。
data.lighting: 车库昏黄工作灯与机车镀铬配件反射的温暖金属光泽
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet private garage at night, Amane leans beside her parked motorcycle with one knee-high boot planted on a metal service stand and one hand steadying the handlebar. Overhead work light glints off chrome parts and her flushed skin.
data.nsfwProse: Her front-zip black leather riding bodysuit is unzipped wide to bare her breasts and waist, while her free hand slips down past the loosened leather between her thighs.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against her parked motorcycle in the night garage with one booted foot propped on the service stand, she grips the handlebar with one hand while her other slips inside her unzipped black leather riding suit as her bare chest heaves.
